name: Twiniti Loop CRM
install: corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec playwright install chromium
start: bash -lc 'for region in US EU UK; do var=DATABASE_URL_Dev_$region; url=${!var}; if [ -n "$url" ]; then echo "[start] migrating $region"; DATABASE_URL="$url" pnpm --filter @twiniti/db db:migrate; else echo "[start] skip $region (DATABASE_URL_Dev_$region not set)"; fi; done'
